budget_derivation.hash_path_note: The raw identity fallback independently streams through its existing bounded POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED path; one full pair pass is nevertheless included in this reserve.
budget_derivation.rate_and_failure_policy: Reserve at most one 768000000 byte advice episode per 20.0 seconds and 320 total; the existing memory.stat eligibility and post-advice gate-plus-512 MB recheck apply to every event. Any event/rate/byte cap or failed recheck preserves the original hard abort.
